cards.text: Last time, Israel demanded a king, and the LORD told Samuel to appoint one (1 Samuel 8:5, 22). Samuel is Israel's prophet and judge (1 Samuel 3:20; 7:15). Now meet Kish, from the tribe of Benjamin, and the text calls him a powerful man.

cards.question: Kish has a son named Saul, choice and handsome, without equal among the Israelites. What else stands out about Saul?

answers.text: He's a head taller than anyone
He's the fastest runner in Israel
He's the strongest man in Benjamin

cards.text: A head taller than everybody. That man has NEVER had to say, "Hey, can you grab that off the top shelf?" One day Kish's donkeys wander off, and Kish sends Saul with one of the servants to go find them.

cards.question: Saul and the servant search the hill country of Ephraim, then Shalishah, then Shaalim, then the land of Benjamin. True or false: they find the donkeys in the land of Benjamin.

cards.text: Still no donkeys, and now they reach the land of Zuph. I once spent a whole afternoon hunting one sprinkle under my oven, so I feel this man's pain.

cards.question: When they reach the land of Zuph, Saul tells the servant they should go back home. Why?

answers.text: His father will start worrying about them
They have run out of daylight
The servant is too tired to go on

cards.text: Saul's right, friend: stay gone long enough and Dad stops worrying about the donkeys and starts worrying about you. But the servant says there's a highly respected man of God in this city, and everything he says surely comes to pass.

cards.question: What does the servant hope the man of God in this city will do for them?

answers.text: Tell them which way to go

cards.text: Saul asks, if they do go, what can they give the man? The bread in their packs is gone, and they've got no gift to take to the man of God.

cards.question: Then Saul's servant speaks up. What does he have in his hand to give the man of God?
The text stops for a quick side note. Back then in Israel, the prophet of today was called the ___.

cards.text: A quarter shekel. Friend, I came home from a bakery's closing sale with a 25 cent sticker on me, so I am NOT judging the budget. Saul says good, let's go, and they head for the city where the man of God is.
They're climbing the hill to the city when they meet some young women coming out to draw water. Saul and the servant ask them, "Is the seer here?"

cards.question: Saul and his servant ask the young women on the hill if the seer is in town. What do the young women answer?

answers.text: He left this morning for Ramah

cards.question: The young women explain the people have a sacrifice on the high place today. True or false: the people won't eat until the seer comes and blesses the sacrifice.

cards.text: Up they go toward the city, and just as they're walking in, somebody's coming right toward them. Friend, God's timing beats every oven timer I've ever owned.

cards.question: As Saul and his servant enter the city, ___ comes toward them on his way up to the high place.

cards.text: Now hold on, friend. The text rewinds one day. The day before Saul showed up, the LORD had revealed something to Samuel.

cards.question: What does the LORD tell Samuel will happen at this time tomorrow?

answers.text: A man from Benjamin will come
A man from Ephraim will come
A man from Judah will come

cards.question: The LORD tells Samuel to anoint this man ___ over His people Israel.
The LORD says this man will save His people from someone's hand. Whose?

cards.text: And the LORD says why. He has looked upon His people, because their cry has come to Him.
Back to the gate. When Samuel sees Saul, the LORD tells him, "Here is the man of whom I spoke; he shall rule over My people."
And Saul walks right up to Samuel in the gateway and asks where the seer's house is. Friend, he's asking the seer for directions to the seer, and he has NO idea.

cards.question: Samuel tells Saul he's the seer. Then he gives Saul an invitation. What is it?

answers.text: Eat with him at the high place today
Wait at the city gate until evening
Meet him back here next week

cards.question: Samuel brings up the donkeys Saul lost three days ago. True or false: Samuel says the donkeys have been found.

cards.text: Saul never said one word about donkeys, friend. Then Samuel goes bigger and asks who all the desire of Israel is upon, if not Saul and his father's house.

cards.question: How does Saul answer Samuel's big words about all the desire of Israel?

answers.text: He says his tribe and clan are the smallest
He says he isn't old enough to lead anyone
He says his father needs him back at home

cards.text: Smallest tribe, least clan. Saul's basically asking if Samuel's got the wrong guy, and friend, I once asked an angel if he had the right drawer, so I GET it.

cards.question: Samuel brings Saul and his servant into the hall and seats them in the place of ___ among about thirty guests.

cards.text: Then Samuel tells the cook to bring the portion he gave him and told him to set aside.

cards.question: The cook sets the leg and what was attached to it in front of Saul. True or false: Samuel says it was kept for Saul for this occasion.

cards.text: Samuel had a seat saved and a plate waiting before Saul even knew he was coming to dinner. Saul dines with Samuel that day, and back down in the city, they talk up on Samuel's roof.
Just before dawn, Samuel calls up to Saul on the roof to get ready, and they head out together. At the edge of the city, Samuel tells Saul to send the servant on ahead.

cards.question: Samuel tells Saul to stay behind for a while at the edge of the city. Why?

answers.text: So Samuel can reveal the word of God
So Samuel can pray for his family
So Samuel can bless his trip home

cards.question: Alone with Saul at the edge of the city, Samuel takes out a flask of oil. What does he do with it?

answers.text: Gives it to Saul to keep

cards.text: Then Samuel kisses him and says, "Has not the LORD anointed you ruler over His inheritance?" No crowd. Just two men at the edge of the city.
Then Samuel tells Saul what's going to happen when he leaves. First he'll find two men at the tomb of Rachel, Jacob's wife (Genesis 29:28), in Zelzah on the border of Benjamin.

cards.question: The two men at Rachel's tomb will tell Saul the ___ he's looking for have been found.
True or false: the two men will also say Saul's father has stopped worrying about the donkeys and started worrying about Saul.

cards.text: Saul CALLED that one back in Zuph, friend. Next, at the Oak of Tabor, three men going up to God at Bethel will meet him, carrying three young goats, three loaves of bread and a skin of wine.

cards.question: The three men at the Oak of Tabor will greet Saul. What will they give him?

cards.text: Then at Gibeah of God, where the Philistines have an outpost, Saul will meet a group of prophets coming down from the high place, prophesying. They've got harps, tambourines, flutes AND lyres out in front, so friend, this isn't a walk, it's a parade.

cards.question: When Saul meets that group of prophets, what does Samuel say will happen to him?

answers.text: The Spirit of the LORD will rush upon him
He will be handed a harp and told to play
He will be chased off by the Philistines

cards.question: True or false: Samuel says Saul will prophesy with the prophets and be transformed into a different person.

cards.text: When these signs come, Samuel says, Saul should do as the occasion demands, for God is with him. Then Samuel tells him to go ahead of him to Gilgal, where Samuel will come to offer sacrifices.

cards.question: Samuel tells Saul to wait at Gilgal for ___ days until he comes to show Saul what to do.

cards.text: As Saul turns to leave Samuel, God changes Saul's heart, and all the signs come to pass that day.
At Gibeah a group of prophets meets him. The Spirit of God rushes upon him, and Saul prophesies right along with them.

cards.question: Everyone who knew Saul before sees him prophesying with the prophets. What do they ask one another?

answers.text: Whether Saul is also among the prophets
Whether Saul is going to be king

cards.text: A man who lives there answers, "And who is their father?" and "Is Saul also among the prophets?" becomes a proverb. Friend, Saul left home looking for donkeys and came back a SAYING.
When Saul finishes prophesying, he goes up to the high place. Then Saul's uncle asks where he and the servant went, and Saul says they looked for the donkeys, then went to Samuel.

cards.question: Saul's uncle wants to know what Samuel said to them. What does Saul tell him?

answers.text: That the donkeys had been found

cards.question: True or false: Saul tells his uncle what Samuel said about the kingship.

cards.text: We'll pause right here, friend. Keep your apron on, because Saul's story has a LOT more coming.

findings.problem: "Samuel had a seat saved" adds a detail the text doesn't give. 9:22 says only that Samuel seated them in the place of honor. Only the portion is said to be kept back (9:23-24). The line also reads like a pleasant summary rather than a real laugh.

rule.text: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
